issues: The four allergy/seasonal footnotes are printed on pages 2-8 (repeated per page); listed once. The '*' 24-hour note is printed on pages 6 and 7; the '*' items are LAMB SHOULDER and BEEF SHORT RIBS (ASADO STYLE).

Wine section headings (RARE VINTAGE WINES, RED WINES, WHITE WINES, ROSÉ WINES, PORTO & SEMI SWEET WINES, SPARKLING WINES & CHAMPAGNES) appear at the END of each page's text dump (pp.10-17), so assignment is inferred by page: p10 France+Italy = Rare Vintage; p11-12 = Red; p13-14 = White; p15 = Rosé; p16 = Porto & Semi Sweet; p17 = Sparkling. Verify visually.

Wine items with two prices (e.g. '20 $' then '100 $') are unlabeled in the text (likely glass/bottle but NOT printed); split into two items each, with the price in the name in parentheses, e.g. 'SARAFİN (20 $)'. Same for CHEVAL NOIR (15/70, three wines), SAN GIOVANNI PERINI (15/50, two wines), KAVAKLIDERE İNCİ DAMLASI (20/80), KAVAKLIDERE SULTANİYE (20/70), Sarafin and Kavaklidere Selection (20/100). Wine prices are printed '120 $'; food prices '$ 37'.
Wine names and grape/region lines are one language only: copied to both tr/en and detailTr/detailEn. Country sub-headings likewise.

PDF text has stray lowercase 'i' inside capital words (SAiNT, PiNOT, ViOGNiER, RiOJA, 'AıX'); normalised to capital I. Other typos kept as printed: 'TALY' (Ricossa Gavi, white), 'CHATEUA D'ESCLANS', 'GRAND C RESERVE' (probably truncated), 'SEVİLEN R ROSÉ', 'ST. JULEN', 'SAINT - ÉMILION' spacing, 'T- BONE'. Page 15 Opale Rosé etc. kept.

Duplicates kept as printed: SARAFİN Chardonnay twice in white wines (identical lines); KAVAKLIDERE COTES D'AVANOS twice (different grapes); LE BIJOU in white (70) and rosé (50); GRAND C RESERVE in red (100) and white (70); CLOUDY BAY twice (different grapes).

SOUP: the EN name and TR name are on separate lines; 'GARLIC AND VINEGAR SAUCE / SARIMSAK VE SİRKE SOSU' placed as the description. TRIO BURGER description (MINI DIAMOND BURGER, MINI CHEESEBURGER, MINI BEEF BURGER) is printed in English only (detailTr null). Weights in names (e.g. 'KASAP KÖFTE 225 G') kept in the name. Butcher-style meatballs and meatballs with cheddar have no separate description.
Names split around the price in the text dump were rejoined: BEEF TENDERLOIN WITH CAFÉ DE PARIS SAUCE (TR line 'CAFÉ DE PARİS SOSLU DANA BONFİLE 180-200 G') and OYSTER MUSHROOMS WITH CHEDDAR SAUCE.

BEEF DISHES has sub-headings JAPANESE WAGYU, US CUT IMPERIAL GOLD, US CUT PRIME CHOICE, ARGENTINA CUT HOUSE SELECTION (no direct items). BEEF SHORT RIBS (ASADO STYLE) sits at the end of US CUT PRIME CHOICE in the dump, just before the ARGENTINA CUT heading; verify visually. Chateaubriand 450 G (for 2) and 850 G (for 4) are separate printed items with own prices.

DOCX vs PDF structure: DOCX has NO prices and NO wine list. DOCX 'MEATS / ETLER' is one flat list without the Japanese Wagyu / Imperial Gold / Prime Choice / Argentina grouping; DOCX lacks Wagyu items and the 100-120 G cuts; origins in DOCX (DALLAS STEAK FROM MESOAMERICA, T-BONE FROM MESOAMERICA, TOMAHAWK FROM IRELAND) are not in the PDF. DOCX 'FROM LAMB / KUZUDAN' vs PDF 'LAMB DISHES / KUZU ETLERİ'; 'LAMB RIB / KUZU KAFES' vs 'LAMB RACK / KUZU KABURGA KAFES'.

DOCX vs PDF wording: SOUP 'KOLEJENLİ' vs 'KOLAJENLİ'; 'ARUGULA PARMESAN SALAD / ROKA PARMESAN SALATASI' vs 'ARUGULA SALAD WITH PARMESAN CHEESE / PARMESAN PEYNİRLİ ROKA SALATASI'; 'TULUM CHEESE SALAD' vs 'SALAD WITH TULUM CHEESE'; BEEF SUSHI desc 'TENDERLOIN/KONTRAFİLE' vs 'SIRLOIN STEAK/KONTRFİLE'; 'STEAK SPAGHETTI / ET SPAGETTİ' vs 'SPAGHETTI WITH BEEF STEAK / BİFTEKLİ SPAGETTİ'; 'SMOKED RIB WITH CHEDDAR SAUCE / CHEDDARLI FÜME' vs 'SMOKED RIBS WITH CHEDDAR SAUCE / CHEDDAR SOSLU FÜME KABURGA'; 'GRILLED GODEN SUJUK' vs 'GRILLED GÖDEN SAUSAGE'; 'STEAK KOKOREÇ' vs 'BEEF KOKOREC / DANA ETLİ KOKOREÇ'; 'CLASSIC CHEESEBURGER / KLASIK CHEESEBURGER' vs 'CHEESEBURGER'; DOCX Diamond Burger TR omits chipotle; DOCX 'MİNİ ÇİZ BURGER'; 'MEATBALL WITH CHEESE / KASARLI KÖFTE' vs 'MEATBALLS WITH CHEDDAR CHEESE / CHEDDAR PEYNİRLİ KÖFTE'; 'BEEF TENDERLOIN PIECES' vs 'MILK-FED VEAL TENDERLOIN PIECES'; 'TENDERLOIN WEDGES / BONFİLE TAKOZ' vs 'BEEF TENDERLOIN MEDALLIONS / DANA BONFİLE MADALYON'; 'NEW YORK STEAK / KONTRFİLE' vs 'NEW YORK STRIPLOIN / DANA KONTRFİLE'; 'LEAF RIB / YAPRAK ANTRİKOT' vs 'THIN-SLICED RIBEYE / YAPRAK ANTRİKOT'; 'SAUCES & GARNISHES' vs 'SAUCES & SIDE DISHES'; 'PORTO SAUCE' vs 'PORT WINE SAUCE'; 'KREMALI MANTARLI SOS' vs 'KREMALI MANTAR SOSU'; 'CREAMY MUSHROOM SPINACH' vs 'CREAMED SPINACH WITH MUSHROOMS'; 'ÇEDAR' vs 'CHEDDAR'; 'OILY PISTACHIOS / YAĞLI ANTEP FISTIĞI' vs 'WITH PISTACHIOS / ANTEP FISTIKLI'; DOCX footnote wording differs ('RESTAURANT PERSONELİNE', 'İHTİYACINIZ').
